body_markdown:
Bowman has been recognized as one of the nation’s leading mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) firms in the 2026 MEP Giants report by[Consulting-Specifying Engineer (CSE)](https://www.csemag.com/events-and-awards/mep-giants/) , which highlights the top 100 MEP and fire protection engineering firms across North America. Bowman ranked #79 on this year’s list, marking our highest-ever placement to date.


Each year, CSE’s MEP Giants program provides a snapshot of the industry’s leading firms and the evolving MEP and fire protection engineering landscape. The annual report recognizes firms demonstrating engineering excellence and leadership as they respond to changing demands across the built environment.


Bowman’s rise on this year’s list reflects the strength of our growing MEP practice and our ongoing investment in the people and capabilities that support clients across the built environment. This recognition is a testament to the knowledge and dedication of our teams as we continue to expand our multidisciplinary capabilities, strengthen our market presence and deliver solutions that create lasting value for our clients.
